SpliceWhen.doc: Where, relative to the host DML's row write, this splice emission occurs. Distinct from the parser's TriggerTiming because INSTEAD OF is a third splice mode (replaces the host write entirely) rather than a flavor of BEFORE/AFTER.

Before.doc: Splice point ABOVE the host row-write opcodes. Bound to triggers with timing=Before.

After.doc: Splice point BELOW the host row-write opcodes. Bound to triggers with timing=After.

InsteadOf.doc: Splice point that REPLACES the host row-write entirely. Bound to triggers with timing=InsteadOf. Permitted only when the host object is a view (compiler-enforced).

TriggerContext.doc: Compile-time state needed to lower one trigger body. Carries the trigger's event/timing for OLD/NEW availability checks; carries register-slot lists for the row's pre-image (old_image) and post-image (new_image) so OLD.col / NEW.col references resolve to register copies; carries the host table's column_names for index lookup; carries a depth counter for the recursive-trigger guard. Targets implement reference fields (old_image, new_image) using their idiomatic borrow form — none of the lifetime / pointer-ownership detail leaks into this spec.

compile_trigger_splice.doc: Emit, into the host VDBE program currently under construction in `ctx`, the body fragments for every trigger in `triggers` that matches (host_table, host_event, splice). Triggers fire in registration order. WHEN predicates compile into a per-trigger conditional gate. OLD/NEW availability is enforced per the table in master.md. Recursion is guarded by ctx.trigger_stack and the recursive_triggers PRAGMA; depth is bounded by MAX_TRIGGER_DEPTH (defined in /parts/storage/parts/triggers/). Returns Ok(unit) on success; raises a CompileError annotated with the offending trigger's name on failure.

bind_old_new.doc: Install the OLD/NEW register-slot lists into `ctx`'s active TriggerContext stack so that a body statement's column references through OLD.col / NEW.col resolve correctly. Idempotent within one trigger; paired with unbind_old_new on body completion.

unbind_old_new.doc: Pop the most-recently-pushed TriggerContext from `ctx`. Called after all body statements of one trigger have been lowered.

events_compatible.doc: True iff a trigger declared with `tr_event` should fire on a host DML carrying `host_event`. INSERT vs INSERT and DELETE vs DELETE are trivial; UPDATE matches when either the trigger's column-restriction list is empty (any column) or it overlaps the host UPDATE's SET-list columns.

timing_matches.doc: True iff a trigger declared with `tr_timing` should fire at splice point `splice`. Pure mapping: Before↔Before, After↔After, InsteadOf↔InsteadOf.
